tool.on: Ghost movement: ON (click to turn off)
tool.ready: Ghost movement: off (click to move through walls)
tool.off: Ghost movement: turned off by the GM

clip.what: While this is on, you can move your own tokens straight through walls, doors and other creatures. Your tokens look see-through so you can tell it's on.
clip.on: It's on. Click again to walk normally.
clip.ready: Click to switch it on. Click again to switch it off.
clip.combat: It switches off while a fight is running on this map, and you can switch it back on when the fight ends.
clip.off: The GM has switched it off for now.
clip.vision: Careful: walking through a wall means you see what's on the other side.

gm.off: Player ghost movement: OFF (click to allow)
gm.exploration: Player ghost movement: exploration only (click to turn off)
gm.always: Player ghost movement: always allowed (click to turn off)

clip.what: Lets players move their own tokens through walls and creatures with the ghost button in their token tools. Your own unconstrained-movement tool is separate.
clip.modes: Click to turn it off for everyone. Click again to restore the previous mode. Choose between Exploration only and Always allowed in Settings, Pentaryn Movement.
clip.combat: Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene.

blocked.off: The GM has turned ghost movement off.
blocked.combat: Ghost movement is off while a fight is running on this map.

cleared.off: The GM turned ghost movement off. Your tokens are stopped by walls again.
cleared.combat: A fight started: ghost movement is off. Your tokens are stopped by walls again.

policy.name: Player ghost movement
policy.hint: Lets players move their own tokens through walls and creatures with a ghost button in the token tools. Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene. The GM toolbar button next to it flips this off and back on.

ownedOnTop.name: Show my own tokens on top
ownedOnTop.hint: Your own tokens are drawn above everyone else's, and take the click when tokens overlap. Only on your screen; nothing on the map changes for anyone else.
